name: overpriced-water-co
description: Browse and buy absurdly premium bottled water. Catalog, cart, and checkout are all available as tools; payment is completed by a human on a Stripe Checkout page.

endpoints.notes: Stateless. Carry the X-Cart-Id header returned by create_cart to persist a cart across requests.

webmcp.notes: The same tools are registered on document.modelContext in-page for browser agents.
